literal: Sesame-split like smallness it has indeed even if, internal enmity contains is ruin.
translation: Even if it is as tiny as the split of a sesame seed, internal enmity carries ruin within it.
modern: எள்ளின் பிளவைப் போல மிகச் சிறிய அளவினதாக இருந்தாலும், உட்பகையானது தனக்குள்ளேயே அழிவைக் கொண்டிருக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the hidden danger of internal enmity by comparing it to the split of a sesame seed. A sesame seed is already tiny, and a split of it represents an almost imperceptible measure. The poet warns that even if discord within a group seems this insignificant, it inherently contains the seeds of total ruin. The word ullatu emphasizes that destruction is not an external threat but is carried within the enmity itself.
